# Ride a release without breaking pinned tooling {#recipe-updates}

**Tool:** kailash (nixos-rebuild / flake update) · **Section:**
Administrator · **Level:** medium · **Time:** ~30 minutes ·
**Layer/Category:** admin · **Tags:** admin, updates, release

## Problem

Kailash updates ride the YYYY.NN release ladder (`2026.01` →
`2026.02`, staged `-alpha.N`/`-rc.N` cuts, material re-cuts dotted
like `2026.01.1`). Pulling a newer lock moves versions; you want the
update without surprise breakage, with documentation that says what
moved.

## Solution

<!-- PENDING: the exact rebuild/update verb sequence is being proven
against the 2026.01 release tooling; the guide's updates chapter
governs until this recipe is worked. Never invent flags. -->

Expected output shape:

```
old lock: <rev>  ->  new lock: <rev>
tools moved: <n> (guide pages regenerated for those tools)
```

## Discussion

The no-surprise contract is the version-lock system: every tool's
docs page carries the pin it was written against, and a moving pin is
a red-regenerate event enforced by CI — the same contract binds this
book's recipes.
